text: The holding cost is recorded through one additive write on the asset base of rwb-asset, on /api/recovery/asset/v1 with the HoldingCost element and the Asset and disposal right C, and its operation name is a design name until the baseline review of RWB-S5-E3025-CON fixes it.
why: No source gives the service a cost operation: the Ownership Map and TSD S5 T-A.1 give six operations and none of them records a cost, and the only write of the legacy endpoint table is POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations, which the Ownership Map ruling keeps with rwb-valuation (S1) under ASM-A6-api-6, so without a declared surface the app story cannot be built on Day 1.

text: The cost kinds are maintenance, insurance and custody, published as the closed list LOV-HOLDING-COST with the values MAINTENANCE, INSURANCE and CUSTODY, read as reference data with its version and never written as a constant of the code.
why: The legacy story and the FSD A2.7.1 describe the feature as recording maintenance, insurance and custody costs and give no list, while BR-S5-007 forbids a value a business person may change from being written in code, so the three words of the source become one versioned reference list and not a code enumeration.

text: The cost is recorded on the columns the data model already gives: the kind, the amount, the currency, the invoice date, the vendor reference and the work-order reference are facts of the record and the decision record, the running total is holding_cost_to_date (DF-COL-042), and no new column and no new table is declared by either story.
why: TSD S5 T3.1 gives asset no cost field beyond holding_cost_to_date and no source authorises a cost table, while the feature needs the kind and the amount to be visible and auditable, so the facts are carried on the existing column and in the decision record and the schema question goes to step D1 instead of being answered by an invented migration.

text: R-DIS-37 stays word for word in the legacy criterion AC2 because the legacy master owns it, this story records no bid of its own, and the bid is recorded against the round and the asset by API-S5-005 and the pricing and auction stories; the cost step evaluates R-DIS-10, R-DIS-11 and R-DIS-12 instead.

text: The ACE asset, collateral and score facts reach rwb-asset only on the rwb-source-data data-product contract, and the service holds no grant on any recovery.v_ace_* view, so DP-05 is stated as a prohibition and no v_ace_* path or property is declared by the app or by the contract.
why: The context pack and the architecture keep the v_ace_* views read only by rwb-source-data, the legacy story reads v_ace_npa_asset directly, and the FSD field catalog is written against those views, so the realignment has to move the read to the owner contract and record the prohibition instead of reproducing the legacy read.
